title: Did U see Judy - MANU LANVIN

lines.l: Back the things I said
Ghosts' lips in my bed

Walking down Fifth Avenue

Riding home on the uptown train
Did you call my name out in the dark?
Thought I saw her face in Central Park
Did you see Judy in the city lights?
I'll be searching till the model comes
Since she walked out and she'll stay right
Someone help me bring my girl back home
Heard you saw her with another man
Shining down the ring on her hand
Was happiness in her eyes
Like the day before she said goodbye
Did you see Judy in the city of lights?
I've been searching till the moon comes
Since she walked out of it, she stood right
Someone help me with my girl back home
Did you see Judy in the city lights?
I'll be searching till the morning comes
Since she walked out, it just ain't right
Someone help me bring my girl back home
Did you see Judy in the city lights?
I'll be searching till the morning comes
Jazz Radio Blues
